lazy_apply_delayed_execution: lazy apply an eager function to lazy Dask or JAX arrays, deferring execution until the graph is materialized
lazy_apply_numpy_conversion: lazy apply a NumPy-only function to Array API compliant arrays by converting inputs via as_numpy flag
lazy_apply_multi_output: lazy apply a function returning multiple arrays and specify per-output shapes and dtypes
lazy_apply_jax_jit: lazy apply an eager function inside jax.jit using jax.pure_callback to forward to eager JAX arrays
lazy_apply_dask_wrapper: lazy apply a function to Dask arrays by wrapping with dask.delayed and rechunking inputs into a single chunk
